> **Unsigned preview.** `boltget-{version}-windows-x64-setup.exe` installs the Boltget app for your Windows account, without administrator rights; `boltget-{version}-windows-x64.zip` is the command line on its own. These builds are not code-signed yet (signing arrives with v1.0), so Windows SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC" the first time. Check the file against `SHA256SUMS` or with `gh attestation verify`, then choose **More info** and **Run anyway**. Previews do not update themselves: install the next one over this one. Uninstall from Settings, Apps; your downloaded files stay where they are.
